headline: Java4Shell RCE flaw (CVE-2026-114938) in Java apps; Optimizely confirms malicious code on customer sites; Puppet Enterprise bug added to KEV

bullets.text: New, critical: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) allows remote code execution in major Java applications, per BleepingComputer; The Register says Oracle has disclosed it and many third-party apps are exposed. 5 outlets are covering it.

Developing, critical: Optimizely confirmed hackers put malicious code into customer sites (The Record). SecurityWeek says a vulnerability was exploited; Krebs reports attackers used Optimizely to A/B test malware on top websites. No CVE or fix is given.
New in CISA KEV: Perforce Puppet Enterprise deserialization flaw CVE-2026-115731, added 11-17 with a federal due date of 12-01.

New: Japan took the Fugaku supercomputer offline after a cyberattack; DataBreaches.net says data of 4,597 users is at risk. Google reports an AI agent writing and launching exploits with no human in the loop.

Still active: Uber says nearly 150,000 people were hit by a third-party breach; The Register says driver license data was taken from an AI vendor. Also new: suspected breach at 43 Irish credit unions and an Ipsos internal system breach.

Context: cloud keys leaked in Docker Hub images are stolen within seconds (BleepingComputer). SITCON 3 unchanged; 7-day score is 0.76x the 90-day average; n0n (78) and the gentlemen (42) lead leak-site claims.

actions: Inventory Java runtimes and Java-based apps you run; follow Oracle and vendor guidance for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) and patch as soon as fixes are available.
Optimizely users: audit Optimizely snippets and third-party scripts on your sites for unexpected changes and follow Optimizely's guidance.
Puppet Enterprise admins: apply the fix for CVE-2026-115731 (KEV, due 12-01) and restrict access to the Puppet server.
Scan container images before pushing to Docker Hub for embedded cloud keys; rotate any key that was ever in a public image.
Expect breach-themed phishing after the Uber and credit union breaches; verify notices through official channels before acting.
Queue KEV fixes: SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 due 11-20; Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium due 11-24.
